doc.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Closing remarks and goodbyes
summary: Hope to return to Hamilton, more episodes of the show, and thanks and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And you can’t slow down your schedule until we have you back at Hamilton.
Oh, there are some of the greatest gigs up there, really, always fun and yeah. I’ve been coming up there for a long time it seems. So thank you.
Okay. You take care and keep jamming in the kitchen.
We’ll do a couple of more episodes and then we’ll reassess. Because it does take up a lot of time in the editing process but it’s been a lot of fun.
Great. I enjoyed reconnecting with you.
Yes, me too. I did too. Thank you very much. Thanks for the opportunity.
Bye-bye. See you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
